profile.headline: Software Engineer at Saks Global
profile.summary: Hi, I'm David Hernandez. I'm a passionate and results-driven software engineer with experience in JavaScript, React, Node.js and AWS cloud solutions. I’m committed to developing clean and delivering high value solutions. I’m a highly collaborative team player that enjoys meshing and working with my fellow engineers even in remote settings. I’m always striving to learn new technologies and continuously improve and refine my current skill set. Let's chat!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Partnered with other engineers to build a redesigned credit application using a React client paired with cutting edge AWS serverless solutions such as API Gateway, Lambdas, DynamoDB, Step Functions, while maintaining observability leveraging tools like Splunk and New Relic.
•	Applied various design patterns to improve readability of code and decreased WIP time.
•	Participated in scrum activities like standup, refinements, and retrospectives.
•	Provided valuable insight about consumer behavior, based on previous dealership retail experience, to improve the overall user experience of our product.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with other engineers on designing, developing, testing, and implementing new Java/Spring Boot RESTful web services.
•	Reviewed and tested existing code to discover and fix bugs.
•	Embraced new challenges such as learning Splunk’s SPL to create reports and dashboards to display data visualisations for management. 
•	Provided valuable insight about consumer behavior, based on previous dealership retail experience, to improve the overall user experience of our product.

positions.title: TurboLog | React, Redux, Material UI, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, S3
positions.description:
•	User-friendly application for logging maintenance services done on a vehicle into one centralized app with a Garage, Log History and Forum section. Written in React Hooks syntax.
 
•	Personally worked on Home, Authentication, Garage(Viewing, adding, editing, deleting vehicles, viewing and adding Service records) and Best Practices sections of the site.

positions.title: Brraaap! | React, Redux, Base Web UI, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL
positions.description: • Hosted e-commerce site with a focus on selling motocross and ATV safety gear for new and experienced riders.

positions.title: Parts Assistant Manager
positions.description:
•       Achieved 142% sales-quota employing customer-centric strategies.
•       Fielded calls from motorcycle and ATV enthusiasts that need assistance with ordering parts for their vehicles, as well as, accessories and safety gear.
 •     Hired, trained and managed a small group of parts associates and aided with any questions about products or customer relations. 
•      Analyzed and compared sales data with other metric motorcycle dealerships across the US in search of areas where the team could improve. 
•      Handled over $500,000 in revolving inventory and made sure sales floor was properly stocked with product.

positions.title: Senior Parts Associate
positions.description:
•       Achieved 153% sales-quota by coupling robust product knowledge with strong customer relations.
•	Initiated successful outside lead generation campaigns without management guidance in an effort to increase sales outside of storefront.
•	Interact and inform walk-in customers about proper motorcycle safety gear and performance parts, as well as, sell genuine Yamaha, Suzuki, Kawasaki and Can-Am hard parts. 
•	In over one year, sold over $500,000 worth of parts, accessories, and apparel for imported sport bikes, cruisers, Jet Skis and WaveRunners, and ATVs . Set records for amount sold in one day and amount sold in one month.
•	Customized units with variety of parts and accessories.
•	Formally trained and accountable for products made by over 100 brands of performance parts and accessories.
